# companion-status

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The agents' part of every companion's status line (Companion.Status 'agents' — the menu-bar tray's header, later the browser extension's): from useConversations(), partitioned like the agent manager's home — working or starting → 'N agents working', waiting → 'N need you' — with attention while any agent waits on the user, which the companion shows as its attention (the menu-bar icon's dot).
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Companion.Status` "Agents"
  - Uses:
    - `companions/panel.Companion`
    - `conversations.useConversations`
